category_edits.rationale: Expand each SASRec feed-forward sublayer to hidden_dim → 4*hidden_dim → hidden_dim with GELU to increase nonlinear capacity. Preserve dropout, residual connections, normalization, causal attention and all training settings. The embedded predictor imports SASRec from train.py, so it automatically reconstructs the updated architecture and loads one checkpoint per category.

self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(hidden_units, 4 * hidden_units, kernel_size=1)
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.relu = nn.GELU()

        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
